name: The Moon Basket — Spring Blush
story: A full moon of handmade paper, carried by its arch, holding a spring garden inside.
description: A circle of textured handmade paper, cut open at the top into a smooth arch you can carry it by, cradling blush-pink roses and soft pink gerbera daisies among lilac chrysanthemums, clouds of gypsophila and sprigs of golden solidago. Finished with a lilac ribbon at the base. It stands on its own on a table, and the arch means it can be carried by hand or hung on a door handle. Hand-arranged fresh in Jaipur. Flowers may vary slightly with market availability; we always keep to the same colours and style.
deliveryInfo: Same-day delivery across Jaipur: order by 2 PM for delivery by 6 PM; later orders arrive by 12 PM. Free delivery across Jaipur. Arrives ready to display — no vase needed.
